messages:
Carmen: Quick sync on Asterion Labs case spotlight + co-hosted webinar with CloudBridge. Need: interview permissions, pull-quote approvals, a 5-min live demo slot, recording consent on reg, and lead routing split (AE + partner). Brief: https://redwood.docs/asterion-brief :spiral_calendar:
Dev: I'll schedule interviews. Who are spokes? Asterion CTO + Head of ML. CloudBridge product lead for the partner segment?
Carmen: Yes to all. Demo right after the CTO panel. Also want a 30s teaser and 60s promo cutdown. Embargo target Sept 22. Legal signoff by Sept 15.
Iris: Draft pull quote: "Asterion reduced inference latency and costs after migrating to Redwood." Want to push for a percent but will only include if we have an email confirmation. Tagged potential percent lines with [LEGAL].
Samir: For lead routing: registration webhook -> SFDC campaign Asterion-Q3-Partner. Primary assignment: if attendee selects "Request demo" => queue asterion-ae, if "Partner interest" => partner-cloudbridge queue. Add hidden field utm_partner=cloudbridge.
legal-bot: Please avoid raw percentages unless Asterion provides signed confirmation. If they request transcript access with redaction rights, expect +48-72 hours. NDA requests escalate to legal@redwood. Tagging [LEGAL] spots in the transcript.
Carmen: Add consent checkbox copy: "I consent to Redwood contacting me and to the webinar recording being used for marketing purposes." Also add GDPR variant for EU registrants.
Iris: Consent copy added. I've sent the pull quote and the promo script to Asterion and CloudBridge for redline. Asked Asterion to confirm any percent stats by email.
Dev: Doodle sent with Tue/Wed/Thu slots. Will flag calendar events as "Recording  marketing use" and include the consent language in the invite.
Samir: Webhook test passed in staging. Mapping preview: POST -> SFDC campaign=Asterion-Q3-Partner, lead.owner=if(form.demo_request==true) then "queue:asterion-ae" else if(form.partner_interest==true) then "queue:partner-cloudbridge" else "queue:sdm-ops". Also preserve existing owner if not NULL.
legal-bot: If CloudBridge requires co-host approval for promo copy, that might add 2-5 business days. Recommend sending partner script as soon as possible. Also note: redact technical appendix if requested by Asterion.
Iris: Asterion replied: approved quote but asked to remove a latency microbenchmark. They said they'll send an email confirming a 38% inference cost reduction if we include it. CloudBridge wants to review promo voiceover.
Carmen: OK — we'll keep percent out until we have the confirmation email. If Asterion sends the email, legal can fast-track inclusion. For now plan promo cutdowns without the percent.
Samir: I'll configure SFDC to tag partner=true when utm_partner contains "cloudbridge" and set lead.source=webinar. Also add a 24-hour follow-up cadence: AE messages for demo_request leads, partner SDRs for partner leads.
Dev: One more ask: record a clean transcript and flag verbatim quotes with [LEGAL] markers in the edit doc so we can swap lines if redactions happen.
legal-bot: Noted. We'll permit a 72-hour redaction window after transcript sent to Asterion. If they request heavy edits, publish may need to shift.
Carmen: TL;DR: interviews pending Doodle, pull-quote sent and legal-tagged, consent copy added (incl EU variant), webhook/SFDC routing mapped to asterion-ae/partner-cloudbridge, embargo Sept 22, 72-hour redaction window available. Check-in EOD. :rocket:
